palette: light rice-paper ground, deep ink text, cinnabar seals, indigo ribbon, jade accents, warm beige margins
typography: rubbing-hall headings in deep ink with cinnabar rail tabs and indigo chips
composition: a light rubbing hall where contract-conveyance tokens pass or stall at registration gates, layered land bands stack surface-sky-underground, a residence chip crosses the registration gate while transfer chips bounce, and servitude paths fork across need and serving land
